description: Deficiencies noted in periodic KYC updates for high-risk customers. Out of 145 high-risk accounts reviewed, 12 accounts (8.3%) had KYC updates overdue by more than 60 days.
atrText: Bank acknowledges the observation. Immediate steps taken: (1) Automated KYC expiry alerts configured in CBS with 90/60/30 day advance notifications. (2) Dedicated KYC team of 2 officers deployed. (3) All 12 identified accounts updated as of January 15, 2026. (4) Monthly KYC compliance dashboard implemented for ACB review. (5) Staff training on KYC/AML conducted on Dec 20, 2025.

description: CRAR at 8.2% (as on Sep 30, 2025) is below regulatory minimum of 9%. Capital plan approved by Board but execution delayed.
atrText: Draft ATR: Board has approved emergency capital infusion of ₹50 lakhs through share issuance. First tranche of ₹30 lakhs infused in December 2025, bringing CRAR to 10.2%. Remaining ₹20 lakhs to be infused by March 2026. Monthly CRAR monitoring implemented. Capital raising strategy under review for FY 2026-27.

description: NPA classification delays observed. 12 accounts were classified as NPA with a delay of 15-30 days beyond the 90-day overdue mark, indicating gaps in monitoring and MIS.
atrText: Bank accepts the observation. CBS module for automated Days Past Due (DPD) calculation enabled. System now generates daily alerts for accounts approaching 90-day overdue mark. SOP revised to mandate weekly SMA/NPA review meeting. All identified accounts have been correctly classified. Going forward, DPD tracking is automated.

description: Investment broker concentration risk: 62% of investment transactions executed through a single broker during Q3 2025, exceeding prudent diversification norms.
atrText: Bank notes the observation. Management submits that the broker in question (SEBI Reg: INZ000012345) has excellent track record and competitive pricing. However, bank acknowledges concentration risk. Action initiated to empanel 3 additional SEBI-registered brokers by March 2026. Treasury system being configured to track and alert on broker-wise exposure limits (5% cap per broker). Request for further time till June 2026 for full implementation.
